title: Feasibly Functional Features
description: Lightweigt mod that adds tweaks and tools to fix forgotten features and clear up your inventory!
body:
# Feasibly Functional Features

Tweaks and Tools to fix forgotten features and clear up your inventory!



         
## Tiered Upgrades
The following items have capabilities that are upgraded using the Tier Smithing Template and the appropiate material. These tier upgrades can be applied up to three times.

### Bucket
Material : _Iron Alloy_
- Increases capacity for holding fluids
- Advanced Buckets cannot hold mobs

### Glass Bottle
Material _: Iron Alloy_
- Increased capacity for holding potions and other bottleable fluids (Up to 16 potions!)
- Works with brewing! Place an _Alchemy Stone_ in the other two brewing stand slots to do so.
- Allows up to 16 units of potion to be brewed at once, instead of just 3.
- Use the _Splash Module_ and ammo instead of brewing splash potion

### Bundle
Material : _Tough Fabric_
- Increased capacity for holding items, to help inventory management
- All tiers have non-stackable items take up 1 item istead of a full 64

### Minecart
Material : _Iron Alloy_
- Increases travel speed and acceleration

## Module Upgrades
Apply these upgrade items to the appropiate items to unlock new functionality. Simply place the target item and the module on a _Modification Table_ and click using a _Mod Tool_. Active modules have functionality triggerd by the _Activate_ keybind 

### Bundle Auto-Collector
Passive, Applies to: _Advanced Bundle_
- Automatically sorts picked up items into bundle
- Enables double clicking with bundle to quick move items into it
- Prioritizes collecting matching items

### Quiver Module
Active, Applies to: _Advanced Bundle_
- Turns bundle into quiver and increases item capacity
- Only accepts ammunition items listed in the _#all_ammos_ tag 
- Projectile weapons get ammunition from items in the quiver
- Activating this module rotates between valid ammunition
- Only 1 quiver can be used at a time

### Splash Module
Active, Applies to: _Flask_
- Toggled on/off
- Allows right-click to throw potion inside
- Requires splash or lingering ammo to function

### Splash Module
Active, Applies to: Meele Weapons
- Toggled on/off
- Replaces mob item drops with increased xp
- Makes xp farming less time-intensive

### Enchantment Medallion
Active, Applies to: Tools/Boots/Tridents
- Activate to swap between incompatable enchants on upgraded item
- Currently supports the following:
-  - _Fortune / Silk Touch_
-  - _Depth Strider / Frost Walker_
-  - _Riptide / Chanelling+Loyalty_
- One of the enchants must already exist on item to apply module

### Spur
Active, Applies to: Boots
- Applies burst of speed to horse
- Has cooldown between uses

### Golden Trinket
Passive, Applies to: Armor
- Makes piglins passive when placed on worn armor
- Piglins will barter a very high price for spares


## Tools and Equipment

### Adze
Smithing Table
- Made with new _Merge Smithing Template_  by combineing Netherite tools
- Has functionality of Axe and Hoe in one
- Higher durability.

### Mattock
Smithing Table
- Made with new _Merge Smithing Template_  by combineing Netherite tools
- Has functionality of Pickaxe and Shovel in one
- Higher durability.

### Totem of Untethering
Crafting
-Increases range and level of effects from beacons and conduits
-It and totem of Undying are now crafted from Dormant Totems dropped by Evokers

### Horseshoe
Trading, Smithing Table
- Provide materials and payment to Armorer villager for Iron, Gold, and Diamond tiers. 
- Netherite Tier requires upgrade at Smithing Table
- Can be enchanted with Frost Walker, Unbreaking, Feather Falling, and two custom enchantments
- - _Gallop_ Increases effectiveness of using dashing with Spurs
- - _Prance_ Increases jump height and negates some fall damage.
- Increases Horse Speed slightly

### Alchemy Stone
Crafting
- Place in other two slots of brewing stand to enable brewing flasks
- Multiple uses

### Mod Tool
Crafting
- Use at _Modification Table_ to apply or remove modules.
- Multiple Uses

## Blocks

### Modification Table
Crafting
- Place upgradable item on it to apply or remove modules
- Requires _Mod Tool_ to use

### Netherite Sponge
Crafting
- Absorbs both water and lava
- Can hold more fluid than normal sponge
- Fire-proof

### Fletching Table
Crafting
- Now Usable! Can apply potions and glowstone to make tipped and spectral arrows
- Assemble new arrows using fletching, shaft, and Arrowhead material.

## Arrows

### Amethyst Arrow
Fletching Table
- Flies further and faster
- Higher damage at distance, good for sniping
- Negates some damage reduction from enchants

### Echoing Arrow
Fletching Table
- Creates sonic shockwave on hit for AOE damage
- Partially negates both armor and enchantment damage reduction.
- Expensive, so use wisely

### Obsidian Arrow
Fletching Table
- Sligtly increased damage
- Partially negates damage reduction from armor

### Prismarine Arrow
Fletching Table
- Travels best underwater
- Increased damage in water and for mobs weak to water

    
###Tweaks

- Fire Charges can now be thrown!
- Weapons with Fire Aspect can be used as flint and steel to light fires
- Press H when flying to expend rocket for boost
- - Frees up hotbar slot
- - Works with rockets stored in quiver 
- Right click a tamed llama to place a nearby mob on its back
- - Allows mob transport overland
- - Only works on mobs that fit in boats
- - Right click again to take mob off llama.
- Frost Walker lets you walk over powder snow
- - Negates need to carry leather boots with you
- - Works for horses with Frost Walker horseshoes
